release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.9.2 Release — YouTube Selective Channel Blocker & Zero-Tolerance 0-Minute Shield:
• Real-Time Distracting Channel Interception: Automatically inspects YouTube video metadata in real-time. Entertainment, gaming, roasts, and memes (CarryMinati, Total Gaming, Mythpat, Techno Gamerz, etc.) are blocked with an instant ejection and tactical overlay.
• Educational Whitelist Passthrough: Academic lecture channels (Physics Wallah, Khan Academy, NCERT, Vedantu, Unacademy, Mohit Tyagi, Aman Dhattarwal, etc.) stream with 100% zero interference.
• Automated 0-Minute Enforcement: One-tap toggle inside FocusDefend automatically enforces a 0-minute allowance for Shorts and distracting channels without needing to manually configure YouTube or Digital Wellbeing settings.
